plain: Strong greed for what someone else has.

webster.text: A strong or inordinate desire of obtaining and possessing some supposed good; usually in a bad sense, and applied to an inordinate desire of wealth or avarice.

example.quote: We should remember the character which the Scripture requires in Rulers, that they should be men hating covetousness.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, August 10, 1787
